issues.description: Calling-convention/register-preservation inconsistency: The problem statement (Teilaufgabe b) requires that the subroutine set_pixel may not change any registers except EAX (i.e., caller-saved restriction: only EAX may be modified by set_pixel). In the template source, a comment at the position-calculation TODO reads "Attention: save all registers you modify except eax, ebx and esi" which can be read as a conflicting rule about which registers must be preserved. Students can be confused whether the exception in the template comment applies to implementing set_pixel (requirement: only EAX may change) or only to the inline address calculation in main. The solution implementation preserves registers via push/pop and uses EAX for intermediate computation, which is consistent with the problem statement, but the ambiguous template comment remains a conflicting guidance point.
issues.suggestedFix: Clarify and align the register-preservation rules in the problem statement and template. Update the template comment near the position-calculation TODO to explicitly state that it applies only to the ad-hoc address calculation in main (not to set_pixel), and that the set_pixel subroutine must preserve all registers except EAX (i.e., "For set_pixel: only EAX may be changed; save and restore any other registers you use. The comment below applies only to the one-time position calculation in main"). This removes ambiguity for students about where each rule applies.

issues.description: Subroutine label naming mismatch: the problem statement and the template expect/declare the routine name set_pixel (template defines label 'set_pixel:' and main calls 'call set_pixel'). The solution file defines the implementation label with a leading dot as '.set_pixel:' (different identifier). This naming difference between artifacts can confuse students trying to map the required subroutine name in the problem text/template to the reference implementation and may introduce assembly/linking issues if labels are treated as distinct.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a consistent label name across all artifacts. Rename the solution label from '.set_pixel' to 'set_pixel' (remove the leading dot) so it matches the template and problem statement, or update the template and problem text to reference '.set_pixel' consistently. Add a brief comment in both template and solution indicating the expected global label name to avoid future mismatches.
